nary_nodes.label: Ukraine attacks Russian oil refineries
evidence: Ukraine said it has hit two oil refineries in multiple strikes deep inside Russia with patrol boats and other vessels in the Black Sea also hit.
President Volodymyr Zelensky said the Bashneft-Novoil and Slavneft-Yanos refineries were struck in the attacks aimed at limiting oil revenues Moscow "uses to finance" its war.
Yaroslavl regional governor Mikhail Evraev said Slavneft-Yanos was on fire after what he called the "largest enemy drone attack".

nary_nodes.label: Ukraine attacks Black Sea patrol boats and shadow fleet
evidence: Ukraine said it has hit two oil refineries in multiple strikes deep inside Russia with patrol boats and other vessels in the Black Sea also hit.
"Two military patrol boats and shadow fleet vessels were hit" in the Black Sea, referring to tankers used by Russia to illegally export sanctioned oil.

nary_nodes.label: Russia attacks Ukraine's cities and energy facilities
evidence: In Ukraine, three people were killed in the town of Balakliya, Kharkiv region, in an overnight Russian drone attack, the country's state emergencies service DSNS said.
Later on Thursday, five people were killed in Russian strikes on the central Dnipropetrovsk region, local officials said.
In Ukraine's Black Sea port of Odesa, one person was killed when Russia hit two dry cargo ships.

nary_nodes.label: Kherson city blackout
evidence: In the south, the entire city of Kherson lost electricity after a "critical infrastructure facility" was hit overnight, regional head Oleksandr Prokudin said.
Internet monitoring group NetBlocks told BBC Verify it had observed "deep disruption" to connectivity in the Kherson region.

nary_nodes.label: Russia intercepts Ukrainian drones
evidence: The Russian military said its forces intercepted or shot down 605 Ukrainian drones overnight over a number of regions.

nary_nodes.label: Evraev describes largest enemy drone attack on Slavneft-Yanos
evidence: Yaroslavl regional governor Mikhail Evraev said Slavneft-Yanos was on fire after what he called the "largest enemy drone attack".

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky confirms distance of attacked refineries from Ukrainian border
evidence: Zelensky said on Thursday that the struck Bashneft-Novoil refinery in Russia's Bashkortostan republic was about 1,300km (808 miles) from the Ukrainian border, whereas Slavneft-Yanos was almost 700km (435 miles) away.

nary_nodes.label: Evraev reports 93 drones shot down over Yaroslavl
evidence: Evraev said 93 drones were shot down over Yaroslavl region overnight.

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky urges Russia to choose peace
evidence: "Russia must choose peace," Zelensky said, adding that Ukrainian attacks were "strengthening chances for diplomacy".

nary_nodes.label: Kharkiv regional head reports additional casualties in Lozova
evidence: Kharkiv regional head Oleh Synehubov later said that another two people were killed when drones attacked the train station in Lozova. Another eight people were injured.
